issues.detail: All threads fail to meet the minimum message count of 15 and fall short of their respective target_messages_range in the blueprint. TH1 has 13, TH2 has 13, TH3 has 11, TH4 has 12, and TH5 has 13 messages.
Message M6 contains the forbidden term 'scoring' (derived from 'score'). Message M5 explicitly mentions levels/labels for an attribute ('relationship strength (strong/medium/new)').
Task T12 is listed in artifacts_to_reference for TH2 but does not appear in the artifact_refs of any message in that thread.
